subject: S20 contract: Anki extractor + flashcards placement
body:
# Contract S20 -> S15: Anki as an extractor + a placement

I need your registries to exist; if they land with different names, tell me and I adapt. What I register (module `naadi_api/anki/__init__.py`):
```python
register_extractor(kind="anki", sniff=anki.sniff, extract=anki.extract)
   # sniff(head: bytes, name: str) -> bool        ZIP whose members include collection.anki2|anki21|anki21b (+ `meta`)
   # extract(path: Path, *, limits: IngestLimits) -> ExtractedDeck
register_placement(kind="anki", target="flashcards", place=anki.place_cards, undo=anki.undo_cards)
   # place(db, *, user_id, item_id, deck: ExtractedDeck, choices: {"deck_prefix": str|None}) -> PlacementReport
   #   PlacementReport: cards, decks, skipped_media, skipped_audio, duplicates, errors (counts only, no English text)
```
- Everything stays inside `owner_user_id = user`; origin `anki_import`; cards start new in FSRS; idempotent by `(owner_user_id, anki_guid)`.
- The same code is reachable without the ingest graph: `POST /api/anki/import` (multipart `.apkg`, size caps from your `IngestLimits` once present, else 50 MB) -> `ImportReport`.
- Images -> WebP into `user-uploads/{user_id}/anki/...` (your storage helper if you have one; otherwise mine). Audio dropped and counted.
- No LLM, no embedding of imported card text beyond the owner's own index (S07 `ref_type` for flashcards, owner-scoped).
Question for you: what is the final name/location of `register_extractor`/`register_placement` and `IngestLimits`?
